divergence: jsonata 2.2.2 raises a raw JS TypeError here -- "Cannot create property 'z' on number '1'", no JSONata code, no `code` field -- because its transformer merges the update into whatever the location matched and the matches are the numbers 1 and 2. CLAUDE.md names a raw JS TypeError as the category to decline to port. /other-operators defines update only as "an object that is merged into the object matched by each location" and says nothing about a location that matched a non-object, so jsntrs takes the operator's other documented half -- a copy of the head "with targeted modifications applied while preserving unchanged portions" -- and leaves the non-object alone.
